note: spaces toolbar -- platform's own interface for navigation between mail, address book, calendar, tasks, chat, and settings
unified toolbar -- platform's own interface including search, app menu, and titlebar controls
menubar -- platform's own interface with File, Edit, View, Go, message, tasks, and help menus
chat toolbar -- platform's own interface for chat controls including add buddy, join chat, status, and accounts
folder pane header bar -- platform's own interface with more, write message, and get messages buttons
thread pane header bar -- renders: folder message count, quick filter and display controls; the folder name heading is subtracted as user-created
message header toolbox -- platform's own interface with reply, forward, archive, junk, trash, other actions, and star message buttons
message header date label -- renders: timestamp/date computed value for the email
status bar -- platform's own interface including offline status and status text
chat tab no account title placeholder -- platform's own interface copy for when no chat account is configured
chat tab no account description placeholder -- platform's own interface copy for when no chat account is configured
chat tab open IM account wizard button -- platform's own interface control to add a chat account
